quote: “I think if [artificial intelligence] reaches a threshold where it’s as smart as the smartest most inventive human, then I mean it could be only a matter of days before it’s smarter than the sum of humanity.”
claim_summary: On the Beneficial AI 2017 superintelligence panel, says that if AI reaches the level of the smartest human it could take only days to become smarter than all of humanity.
timeline_text: could be only a matter of days (after human-level)
definition_note: smarter than the sum of humanity, after reaching the level of the smartest most inventive human
notes: incidental; secondhand; basis: "I think if [artificial intelligence] reaches a threshold"; found while tracing Hassabis (search hassabis-054). Marketing AI Institute blog post by Mike Kaput, 2017-02-14, quoting the panel "Superintelligence: Science or Fiction?" at the Beneficial AI 2017 conference, Asilomar, held on 7 January 2017 per the post; the bracketed words are the blogger's. Original is the video youtube.com/watch?v=h0962biiZa4, not read. Endorsement conditional on reaching human level; the time from human level to superintelligence is hedged with "could", kept in timeline_text. The words do not say how the jump happens, so no self-improvement frame is coded.
